messages:
samir: Quick review request — new compact compare layout for the model catalog. Posting Figma link + two screenshots. tl;dr: denser rows, badges stacked, persistent filter chips. Looking for accessibility nits and copy tweaks before we ship.

maya: Looking now. quick note: contrast on the 'CPU perf' badge is pretty low in dark mode. Can we use semantic color tokens instead of raw hex?

toni: I like the denser rows but worry about keyboard focus. Did we add a focus ring to each row? Should each row be tabbable or only the 'compare' checkbox?

samir: Good q. Current prototype makes the whole row focusable and pressing Enter toggles the checkbox. Open to changing that.

eli: From an a11y POV, please ensure we use role="row" and role="gridcell" + aria-selected on selected rows. Also provide an aria-label for the compare dialog summary, e.g., "Compare 3 models, median latency highlighted".

lindsey: Copy nit: change 'Pin version' -> 'Pin model version' (clearer). Also badges: 'Latency' -> 'p50 latency' or 'median latency'?

maya: Latency should show both p50 and p95? Maybe tooltip with a tiny histogram. For compact, show p50 and put p95 under it in smaller/lighter text.

toni: Keyboard detail — if the whole row is tabbable, screen readers will announce lots of elements. Maybe keep only the checkbox tabbable and provide a single 'Compare selected' button that is in the toolbar.

design-bot: Design review ticket created: D-4532 — https://design.redwood/d/4532/compact-compare

samir: Agree on keeping checkbox tabbable. Updated prototype plan: checkbox tabbable; row remains click-target but not in tab order. @maya can you check contrast tokens? @eli can you run axe against the current frame?

maya: Will do. Also suggest increasing badge hit-target to 40px for touch; some badges are tiny at mobile widths.

eli: Running axe now... found a missing label on collapsed filter chips and no aria-expanded on filter groups. Need visible labels for icon-only chips or an aria-label fallback.

lindsey: One last microcopy tweak: change toggle 'Show performance badges' -> 'Show performance indicators' — reads cleaner in the toolbar.

samir: Thanks all — I'll push the accessibility and copy changes to the prototype by EOD and update D-4532 with screenshots. :thumbsup:
